description: This source file defines a PatternPairAggregator class for processing and detecting content within pattern pairs (such as XML tags or delimiters) in streaming text. It includes mechanisms for adding patterns, handling pattern matches with registered handlers, and integrating with sentence detection logic. The file seems to be part of a text processing library within the pipecat project.

classes.name: PatternMatch
classes.description: Represents a matched pattern pair with its content, including the full matched text, content, and pattern type.

classes.name: PatternPairAggregator
classes.description: An aggregator class that detects and processes content between pattern pairs in streaming text, supporting custom handlers, pattern registration, and integration with sentence detection.

classes.name: MatchAction
classes.description: Enumeration of actions to take when a pattern pair is matched: REMOVE, KEEP, or AGGREGATE.

methods.name: "PatternPairAggregator" add_pattern( self, type: str, start_pattern: str, end_pattern: str, action: MatchAction = MatchAction.REMOVE, )
methods.description: Registers a new pattern pair with specified start and end patterns, type, and action to detect in the text.

methods.name: add_pattern_pair( self, pattern_id: str, start_pattern: str, end_pattern: str, remove_match: bool = True )
methods.description: Deprecated method for adding pattern pairs; replaced by add_pattern.

methods.name: "PatternPairAggregator" on_pattern_match( self, type: str, handler: Callable[[PatternMatch], Awaitable[None]] )
methods.description: Registers an asynchronous handler to call when a pattern of a specific type is matched.

methods.name: Tuple[List[PatternMatch],str] _process_complete_patterns( self, text: str, last_processed_position: int = 0 )
methods.description: Internal method to find and handle complete pattern pairs in the text since the last processed position, calling handlers as needed.

methods.name: Optional[Tuple[int,dict]] _match_start_of_pattern(self, text: str)
methods.description: Checks if there are incomplete pattern pairs (patterns with a start but no end match yet) in the text.

methods.name: AsyncIterator[PatternMatch] aggregate(self, text: str)
methods.description: Processes input text character-by-character, detects pattern pairs, and yields PatternMatch objects when patterns are completed or sentences are detected.

methods.name: handle_interruption(self)
methods.description: Resets internal state and discards partially processed text when processing is interrupted.

methods.name: reset(self)
methods.description: Clears buffered text and resets the aggregator's internal pattern tracking state.
